messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync: compiling customer asks for tenant onboarding, affinity and SLA gating. Need a single doc with launch criteria. TL;DR: customers request per-tenant bandwidth caps + regional affinity + predictable failover.

Aj Patel: Can you list priority customers and their asks? Also any hard constraints (data residency/SLOs)?

Maria Chen: Top three: FinServe (residency EU, strict SLA 99.95), ChatCorp (latency 60ms p95, wants dedicated slice), EduTech (cost-sensitive, will accept soft isolation + quota).

Sasha Ivanov: Question: do we want to model 'isolation tiers' as product offering? bronze/silver/gold? I prefer three tiers to map to Dedicated/Hosted+isolation.

Kevin O'Rourke: From infra: main tradeoffs are bandwidth and cross-region replication. Soft isolation = logical quotas + shared fleet. Hard isolation = separate pools (higher cost).

Aj Patel: Proposal: Launch criteria: 1) policy DSL v0.1, 2) routing fallback that preserves SLA within 2x latency, 3) billing metering per slice. Anyone object?

Maria Chen: No objections. Add requirement: telemetry per-tenant token-level breakdown and annotation for caching benefits.

Sasha Ivanov: Spec sketch:
```yaml
tenant_policy:
  isolation_tier: bronze|silver|gold
  affinity:
    region: eu-west-1
    fallback: global
  bandwidth_cap: 100Mbps
  sla_p95_latency_ms: 60
```
Keep it minimal.

Aj Patel: Need per-tenant rollout plan and migration playbook. Customers with contracts (FinServe) get canary windows + manual migration.

Kevin O'Rourke: Operational question: can we reuse existing routing templates? We need a mapping from policy -> routing template id. I'll add template index.

deploy-bot: deployment: canary policy-dsl-v0.1 started in eu-west-1 :rocket:

Maria Chen: :thumbsup: I'll consolidate into a single spec doc and assign acceptance tests. Can someone take on rollout checklist?

Sasha Ivanov: I'll own rollout checklist. Will draft today and send PR.

Kevin O'Rourke: I'll scope infra changes and rough cost delta for hard isolation.

Aj Patel: Great. Next sync Friday 10am. Agenda: finalize launch criteria and per-customer cutover plan.
